title: Checkpoint: Pool Work Queue
prompt: Given: `static task_fn pending[8]; static void *pending_arg[8]; static size_t n_pending;` (typedef for `void (*task_fn)(void *)` included). Implement `int pool_submit(task_fn fn, void *arg)` (append; 0 on success, -1 when full or fn NULL) and `size_t pool_execute(void)` (run every pending task in FIFO order, empty the queue, return how many ran).

tests.name: submit and drain in order
tests.hint: FIFO: the drain runs tasks in submission order — a pool that reorders work breaks consumers.

tests.name: drain empties the queue
tests.hint: A second drain finds nothing: the queue was emptied by the first run.

tests.name: refuse bad submissions
tests.hint: A NULL task is refused and the queue stays consistent.
